tables.description: Weighted sea encounters oracle for open-water travel

result.text: A laden merchant vessel flying unfamiliar colors.
A naval patrol scans the horizon for contraband.
A derelict ship drifts, its sails half-furled.
A squall rolls in; the rigging groans.
A thick fog swallows the sea; a bell tolls unseen.
A raider closes fast under black canvas.
Hidden rocks break the surf ahead.
A castaway waves from a speck of a boat.
A great shadow passes beneath the hull.
An uncharted island rises from the haze.
A smuggler's skiff slips between the waves.
A crate of unknown cargo bobs in the swell.
A pale light dances on the water; the crew falls silent.
The sea goes glass-calm, and the hours stretch long.

tables.description: d6 weather and omens table for departure or landfall

result.text: Fair winds and a clear horizon.
Cloud banks gather to windward.
Driving rain; the deck runs with water.
A sudden squall; reef the sails.
A bird crosses the bow—the old hands exchange a look.

tables.description: Cargo and plunder oracle for a seized hold

result.text: Bales of pepper, cinnamon and clove.
Bolt upon bolt of dyed sailcloth and silk.
Crates of foreign coin, still in their wax-sealed bags.
A cache of cutlasses and powder flasks.
A folded chart marked with a private cross.
Jars of quinine and healing salts.
A coop of squawking birds bound for some governor's table.
A framed painting of a forgotten saint.
A bundle of sealed letters, their wax broken.
Nothing but ballast and the smell of bilge.
